plan.rationale: A tattoo studio needs a bold, moody feel rather than clinical or corporate. Night-premium suits the dark, artistic atmosphere of tattooing, and display-condensed gives the headings an inked, graphic edge without tipping into gimmicky. Sections focus on Mags's actual specialities, her collaborative process and her stated hygiene standards, since those are the concrete facts given. No pricing, awards or years in business are claimed as none were stated.

sections.headline: Tats by Mags: Expertly Crafted Tattoos Uniquely You
sections.subheadline: Your canvas, our passion. Custom tattoo designs built around your ideas, your story and your style.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of Mags at work in the studio, tattoo machine in hand, taken from the side so the client's privacy is kept if needed.

sections.heading: Your canvas, our passion
paragraphs: At Tats by Mags, tattoos are more than ink on skin. They're stories, expressions of individuality and lasting works of art. Our mission is to transform your ideas into stunning, personalised tattoos that you'll cherish for a lifetime.

Mags is the heart and soul of the studio, a passionate and talented tattoo artist who specialises in black and grey realism, watercolour and fine line work. She's dedicated to creating unique designs that reflect your personality and style.

items.title: Personalised Designs
items.body: We work closely with you to create custom designs that are uniquely yours, not off-the-shelf artwork.

items.title: Attention to Detail
items.body: Meticulous artistry and precision in every piece, from the first sketch to the final line.

items.title: Comfortable Atmosphere
items.body: Our studio is clean, relaxed and welcoming, so you feel at ease throughout the entire process.

items.title: Exceptional Service
items.body: We're committed to a positive and memorable experience from start to finish.

items.name: Black and grey realism
items.description: Detailed, lifelike tattoos built up in shades of black and grey.

items.name: Watercolour
items.description: Soft, painterly designs with flowing colour and movement.

items.name: Fine line
items.description: Delicate, precise linework for subtle and detailed designs.

sections.heading: Hygiene and safety, taken seriously
sections.body: Your safety is paramount. We maintain the highest standards of hygiene and sterilisation, using only single-use needles and inks and adhering to all health and safety regulations.

photoSlot.brief: A photo of the clean, set-up tattoo station with sterilised equipment laid out, taken before a session begins.

sections.heading: How we bring your idea to life

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We take the time to listen to your ideas and understand the story or style behind them.

steps.title: Collaborate on the design
steps.body: Together we shape the design, refining details until it feels right and truly yours.

steps.title: Final check before we start
steps.body: We make sure every detail is perfect before the needle touches your skin.

steps.title: The tattoo session
steps.body: Your tattoo is created in a clean, relaxed studio environment, with your comfort front of mind throughout.
